title: Hi there!
text:
I’m Erica, a multidisciplinarian who loves tinkering with all kinds of things - art, data and code. I enjoy learning widely, allowing me to connect the dots over various disciplines. This website is still under construction!

Head over to Projects to see my data analytics dashboards, coding builds and process.
Visit Musings for my writing on current trends and affairs, curious rabbit holes, and lessons learned along the way.

Have a look around and thank you for visiting!
